question: what is the field placement requirement for social work and when do you start it
answer:
For the Social Work BSW (Bachelor of Social Work), the recommended plan for students admitted to the major in 2026–2027 starts fieldwork in third-year fall: SWRK 329, Social Work in Agencies and Communities, includes 100 hours of fieldwork. Its note says, “Must be accepted into the major prior to raking this course.” [1]
The plan then lists SWRK 425, Social Work Theory and Practice I, in fourth-year fall with 200 hours in fieldwork (SWRK 329 is a prerequisite); and SWRK 426, Social Work Theory & Practice II, in fourth-year spring with 200 hours in fieldwork (Theory & Practice I is a prerequisite). [1]
Also published: Social Work MSW. [1]

Sources: [1](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/SO-BSW-SWRK)

question: what are the required courses for the music major and are there any that need an audition to get into
answer:
The Music BA has five concentrations, so requirements vary. MUSI 255 Music, History and Culture and MUSI 450 Capstone Seminar in Music are required in every concentration. [1]

Other required courses include:
• Music Education: MUSI 225, 255, 355; MUSI 123, 209, 210, 330, 332, 400; MUSI 450. Also select 1 technique course, earn 8 credits in group performance, and complete 4 applied-music credits (2 in MUSI 130 and 2 in MUSI 230). [1]
• Music Industry: MUSI 255; COMM 202, DATA 101, MUSI 123 or 140, 263, 301, 313, 316, 350; CNTP 388; MUSI 450. Also select 1 course each from the 200-level and upper-level Music and Culture lists, and 2 electives. [1]
• Music Performance: MUSI 255; MUSI 123, 209, 210, 300, 400; MUSI 450. Also select 1 course from each Music and Culture list, 1 technique course and 1 elective; earn 12 group-performance credits, 2 applied-music credits and 2 flexible credits. [1]
• Music Production: MUSI 255; MUSI 120, 123, 210, 223, 261, 363; CNTP 388; MUSI 450. Also select 1 course from each Music and Culture list, 2 production courses and 1 elective; earn 4 group-performance credits. [1]
• Music Studies: MUSI 123, 210, 255, 316; MUSI 450. Also select 3 200-level and 3 upper-level Music and Culture courses, 1 international focus course, 1 related disciplines course, 1 co-op/internship or independent study; earn 4 performance credits. [1]

The lists of courses you may select from are at the [Music BA catalog page](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/AH-BA-MUSI). [1] The plan lists an “Entrance Performance Evaluation (0)” but does not say whether it is an audition or which courses require one. [1] For verified audition information, contact the Center for Student Success (Academic Advising): success@ramapo.edu, (201) 684-7441.

Sources: [1](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/AH-BA-MUSI)

question: what's the course sequence for the graphic design track, like which studio courses come first and what has to be done before the capstone/portfolio class
answer:
The Visual Communication Design BA’s Graphic Design Concentration requires all of: DSGN 219 IDEA DEVELOPMENT; COMM 322 WEB DESIGN; COMM 339 PUBLICATION DESIGN; COMM 372 PACKAGING DESIGN; DSGN 405 VISUAL IDENTITY DESIGN. The major also requires DSGN 110 FOUNDATIONS OF VISUAL COMMUNICATION DESIGN, DSGN 202 FUNDAMENTALS OF INTERACTIVE MEDIA, DSGN 237 GRAPHIC DESIGN, DSGN 239 TYPOGRAPHY, and DSGN 263 PHOTOGRAPHY FOR DESIGNERS or ARTS 207 DIGITAL PHOTOGRAPHY. DSGN 110 prepares students for the next level of VCD production studio courses; no prerequisite is published. [1][3]

The recommended plan for students admitted in 2026–2027 puts COMM 237 in first-year spring; COMM 239 in second-year fall; CREATIVE PRODUCTION AND APPLICATION 1* and COMM 263 in second-year spring; 2* and 3* in third-year fall; and 4* and 5* in fourth-year fall. The plan doesn’t identify which courses those five production categories represent, or prescribe an order for the concentration courses. It places the Capstone Portfolio Course: COMM 404 - OR COMM 405 - (Category 4) in fourth-year spring. Total: 128 credits. [1]

For the major, the catalog lists DSGN 404 SENIOR CAPSTONE: DESIGN or DSGN 405 VISUAL IDENTITY DESIGN. DSGN 404 requires completion of one of COMM 322 WEB DESIGN, COMM 327 MOTION GRAPHICS AND TITLE DESIGN, COMM 339 PUBLICATION DESIGN, or CRWT 102 CRITICAL READING AND WRITING II or CRWT 102S CRITICAL READING AND WRITING II. [1][2] The plan uses COMM course codes where the catalog requirements use DSGN for some courses (including 237 and 239); the pages differ. [1]

Sources: [1](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/programs/AH-BA-VSCD) [2](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/courses/DSGN404) [3](https://catalog.ramapo.edu/courses/DSGN110)
